selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
prepare: python scripts/make_bases.py --dataset wv3 --split train,valid,reduced,full && python scripts/make_bases.py --dataset wv2 --split reduced,full
train: python train_pancoll.py --model MSDDN-in --dataset wv3 --device cuda:0 --max_hours 48 --eval_every 2000 --skip S_MS --tag _skipS_MS --results_dir results_panbase
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm s_ms --train-set wv3 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/s_ms/wv3_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm s_ms --train-set wv3 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/s_ms/wv3_full
python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm s_ms --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/s_ms/wv2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm s_ms --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/s_ms/wv2_full
runtime_note: RR table values were computed in float32 on CPU. On GPU this network's output differs from the CPU result by 0.9-10 dB PSNR even with TF32 disabled (FFT branch; checked 2026-11-23), so evaluate it on CPU (about 15-30 s per test set).
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
